spitzer2002_acid_arrival.locator: Results, Diffusion delay and carbonic anhydrase inhibition, Figures 1 and 2
spitzer2002_acid_arrival.preparation: Isolated rabbit ventricular myocytes. The HEPES comparison is from the companion cohort.
spitzer2002_acid_arrival.observable: Delay between the same rise in free intracellular H⁺ at two downstream regions
spitzer2002_acid_arrival.scope: Separate groups. Free proton arrival depends on buffering kinetics and geometry. The effective diffusivities were inferred from the delay.

figueiredo2014_oxygen_flux.locator: Results, oxygen flux in Figure 6 and unloading in Figure 7
figueiredo2014_oxygen_flux.preparation: Dissolved oxygen crossing a poly(vinyl alcohol) film with or without horse myoglobin
figueiredo2014_oxygen_flux.uncertainty: Reported deviation below 10 percent. Its definition and a pointwise interval for the fold change are unspecified.
figueiredo2014_oxygen_flux.scope: Myoglobin leached during transfer. Crosslinking also affected oxygen unloading and the film. The dissolved oxygen readout integrates all routes.
